record.paper_title: Recent developments and open problems in linear series
record.original_question: Let (R,m) be a regular local ring of dimension n and let I⊂R be an ideal of big height e. Determine whether the strengthened symbolic-power containments listed in Problem 2.8.2 hold, namely whether I^(m) is contained in m^{rn-r}I^r for m≥rn, in m^{rn-r-(n-1)}I^r for m≥ rn-(n-1), in m^{re-r}I^r for m≥re, and in m^{re-r-(e-1)}I^r for m≥ re-(e-1).

evidence.quote: Problem 2.8.2 Suppose (R, m) is a regular local ring of dimension n and I ⊆ R is an ideal with bight(I) = e. Then do the following hold? 1. I(m) ⊆ mrn−r Ir for m ≥ rn. 2. I(m) ⊆ mrn−r−(n−1)Ir for m ≥ rn − (n − 1). 3. I(m) ⊆ mre−r Ir for m ≥ re. 4. I(m) ⊆ mre−r−(e−1)Ir for m ≥ re − (e − 1).

artifact.status_search_result: These strengthened containments refine the Harbourne–Huneke type conjectures on symbolic powers in regular local rings. The basic containments $I^{(hr)} \subseteq I^r$ and $I^{(hr-h+1)} \subseteq I^r$ (Harbourne's conjecture) are known to fail in general (counterexamples exist), but stable versions and the further-strengthened forms with extra factors $\mathfrak{m}^{rn-r}$ or $\mathfrak{m}^{re-r}$ remain active research topics. Recent surveys (Grifo 2018/2019; Grifo–Huneke and follow-ups including the "stable Harbourne–Huneke" results) treat these as open problems in general, with progress in special cases (monomial ideals, F-pure rings, certain configurations of points, space monomial curves), but no full resolution.

status_evidence.title: Symbolic Powers (Grifo lecture notes)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Harbourne–Huneke containment conjectures and their strengthened forms, listing them as open in general.
status_evidence.claim: The Harbourne–Huneke strengthened containments remain open in general, with progress only in special cases.

status_evidence.title: Chudnovsky's conjecture and the stable Harbourne–Huneke containment
status_evidence.snippet: Studies stable versions of the Harbourne–Huneke containments, showing them under additional assumptions.
status_evidence.claim: The stable Harbourne–Huneke containments are proved in special settings, supporting that the general case remains open.

status_evidence.title: A stable version of Harbourne's Conjecture and the containment problem for space monomial curves
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes stable versions of Harbourne's conjecture for space monomial curves.
status_evidence.claim: Strengthened symbolic power containments are partially established, indicating the full conjectures are still open.
